topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
response: On-board storage constraints limit data packet size for time-tagged services, influencing payload power allocation. Time-tagged services require storing data packets between upload and operation start times, affecting capacity and power allocation.
reference_context: SatCom systems face constraints like on-board storage and power limits, impacting service prioritization and resource allocation.
